chapters.reason: The paper introduces explicit latent thought vectors that guide generation, which are internal states (latent vectors) subject to an explicit prior and iterative inference-time computation, aligning with reasoning regulation via internal states.

The model uses a dual-rate optimization with inference-time computation that iteratively refines the latent vectors, matching the progressive refinement concept of step-by-step internalization and iterative updating.

The inference process involves multiple iterations (steps) for latent vectors, introducing iterative computation within the architecture to refine states, akin to layer recurrent execution, though not strictly at the layer level.
